newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on commercials, CBOT.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on commercials, CBOT.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on commercial selling and a lower CBOT soycomplex, and feed wheat fell on commission long liquidation, traders said.
"Cargill was selling. Our oilseeds are way too high compared to the rest of the world," a trader said. May-July spread at $5, 720 Mar-May spread at $1, Jan-Mar $0.50.
Japan bought 10,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
November canola lost $1.10 to $433.80, and January was up $1.30 to $435.80. October flax rose $2.40 to set a new high at $410 as Manitoba Pool bought on the close.
Feed wheat continued its decline after Wednesday's limit down close on commission house long liquidation of the October.
October feed wheat fell $7 to $186.50, December lost $2.90 to $174.50. Limits are expanded to $7.50 until Monday.
November western barley rose $0.80 to $146.50 on overdone sentiments with Cargill buying, February rose $1.70 to $151. Nov-Feb $4, Feb-Mar $0.50.
Cargill bought December oats down the US$5 limit at US$126.20 from Richardson Greenshieds.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats)
